title: Analysis of Skin Lesions for Melanoma Presence by Volatile Spectroscopy Techniques
brief_summary: The purpose of this research study is to determine if a very sensitive chemistry lab analyzer can be used to smell a skin cancer (like melanoma) similar to some dogs.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older
* Seen at the dermatology clinic \& determined to need a skin biopsy of a suspicious lesion

Exclusion Criteria:

* \< 18 years of age
study_population: Patients seen in the dermatology clinic with suspicious skin lesion to be biopsied will have 4 skin swabs, 2 of the skin lesion and 2 of an area of unafflicted skin
